steps.gMinor: Petzold’s “Minuet in G minor”, from the same notebook as the one in {g} major: {g} minor, with two flats ({bFlat} and {eFlat}) and a raised {fSharp}. The left hand has a line of its own, often moving while the right hand holds. The first part ends in {bFlat} major, and is repeated.
steps.gMinorMinuet: Slowly, both hands, the music waiting for you.
steps.gMinorMinuetInTime: Now in time, with the repeat.
